long_biography.plain_text:
Galassi trained in law at the University of Modena and practised administrative law and international arbitration before moving into industry. At Piaggio Aerospace, he advanced from board-level sales and marketing responsibility to chief executive, contributing to the aircraft maker's international relaunch.

He joined Ferretti's board in 2013 and became chief executive the following year. Over twelve years, he directed strategy and day-to-day management while the marine manufacturer returned to growth, expanded industrial capacity and listed in Hong Kong and Milan. His tenure concluded in May 2026, while board roles in international football continued.
